description: This source file defines classes and functions for running behave BDD tests, including the main ModelRunner and Runner classes, handling test execution, setup, cleanup, hooks, and feature parsing.

classes.name: ContextMaskWarning
classes.description: Warning class for context variable overwrites.

classes.name: ContextMode
classes.description: Enum for context usage modes: BEHAVE and USER.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Holds contextual information during test execution, manages layers, cleanups, and attribute access.

classes.name: ModelRunner
classes.description: Core class for running behave models (features), managing execution, hooks, and output capture.

classes.name: Runner
classes.description: Standard behave test runner, handling path setup, hook loading, feature parsing, and execution.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Sets the context or runner to aborted state, halting test execution.

methods.name: use_or_assign_param
methods.description: Uses or creates a context parameter.

methods.name: use_or_create_param
methods.description: Uses or creates a context parameter with a factory function.

methods.name: add_cleanup
methods.description: Adds a cleanup function to be called during context cleanup.

methods.name: execute_steps
methods.description: Parses and executes Gherkin steps from a string within the current feature context.

methods.name: run_model
methods.description: Runs the features, hooks, and manages cleanup, returning success/failure.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts the test run by initializing context and calling run_model.

methods.name: setup_paths
methods.description: Configures the base directory and feature file locations.

methods.name: load_hooks
methods.description: Loads environment hooks from a specified file.

methods.name: load_step_definitions
methods.description: Loads step definitions from specified directories.

methods.name: feature_locations
methods.description: Returns list of feature file locations.

methods.name: run_with_paths
methods.description: Prepares context, loads features, and executes them.
